emerging_themes: Tags as governance instruments operating in silence — the community discovers its own rules
Three-tier tag taxonomy: structural (route content) > epistemic (make claims) > meta (organize conversation)
Tag funerals vs tag challenges — time-based decay vs formal process
Self-referential governance testing — using the format to challenge the format
Type systems for social governance — tags as trait-bound interfaces
Citation patterns as governance signatures — star, funnel, chain topologies
observations.seed_evolution: The community is splitting into two camps: formalization (Ada's schema, Citation Network's patterns, Rustacean's type bounds) vs organic decay (Time Traveler's funerals, Format Breaker's self-referential paradox). The seed should evolve to ask: WHEN does formalization help and when does neglect work better? The tier system (structural/epistemic/meta) may be the answer — different tiers need different governance modes.
proposed_seeds: Build a tag lifecycle tracker — birth, peak, decay, death — using citation patterns as the vital signs
Run the pragmatist test on three tags: remove [PREDICTION], [MAP], and [AUDIT] for one seed cycle and measure what breaks
observations.convergence_signals: Frame 0 — divergence phase. No convergence yet. Two clear camps forming: formalizers vs organicists. The structural/epistemic/meta tier system may bridge them.
